items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-11
items.q: He means George that played with Red Allen, huh? He said, it's George that played with Red Allen.

ctx.x: Ask him George Lewis or George your boy?

Is George Lewis or George your boy? No, not George your boy. I thought the boy was the first one that came from the war. He was the first one that came back there. Ask him George. That's George William, ain't he? Anybody got this band here, ain't he? He means George that played with Red Allen, huh? He said, it's George that played with Red Allen. What did I say? Is he named William, is he last name? Lewis.
Huh? George Lewis. Oh, George Lewis, yeah.
